environment.background_load: Spotlight consumed approximately one CPU core during the final runs; do not compare absolute times with pilots.

method.input: Two native-written zstd Parquet files: 128 rows plus 16384 or 49152 rows; unique 1024-byte ASCII strings, null every 499 rows, three partition strings; dictionary disabled.
method.timer: Complete rewrite including preflight, reader/runtime/JNI, host FileIO, native memory admission, encode and rolling-writer close. Table-writer object construction, fixture creation, full output verification and cleanup excluded.
method.verification: Every content value, null, multiplicity, partition field, file row count, sequence and statistics; positive native groups and parquet-rs footer witnesses with zero fallback for proposed; expected route for previous.
method.scope: Local-file rewrite diagnostics, including optional synthetic per-stream-read latency; no complete-job, remote-I/O, RSS or CPU-efficiency claim.

diagnostic_passes.policy: Initial resource policy: 64 KiB Java transfers, default 2 MiB positioned reads
diagnostic_passes.interpretation: Different series and host load; retain unfavorable within-series comparisons, not cross-series absolute speedups.

diagnostic_passes.policy: First transfer pass: 4 MiB Java transfers, default 2 MiB positioned reads
diagnostic_passes.interpretation: Different series and host load; retain unfavorable within-series comparisons, not cross-series absolute speedups.

diagnostic_passes.policy: Adaptive Java staging cap 32 MiB, still limited by 2 MiB positioned reads
